notes.title: Welcome to Waddle Home!
notes.content:
Today is the day! 

Archiact's proud to announce that Waddle Home is OFFICIALLY RELEASED for the HTC Vive! We're beyond excited to share this challenging, all-ages puzzle game with the world. With the HTC Vive, our favourite penguin puzzle game is more interactive and addictive then ever before.

To celebrate the release, we're happy to offer players with a 30% discount on our game! Don't miss out on your chance to play this awesome game! 

Happy playing, 
The Archiact Team
